controls.label: Last 90 days (default)
controls.on_click: Panel opens with 6 options (All time, Last 7/30/90 days, This month, Last month) plus an Apply button.
controls.observed_after_pick: Panel visible: false. Apply hittable: false. Trigger now reads "Last 90 days". The panel closed on pick, so its Apply button can never be pressed — the selection commits (or is discarded) without the user reaching the control the panel presents as the commit action.
controls.note: Liveness asserted by isVisible() + elementFromPoint hit test at the centre, not by element state.

controls.label: Add filter
controls.on_click: Menu lists the fields not already on the bar: Platform, Type, Amount, Customer

commit_path.reached_apply_note: This menu has no Apply — picking a field commits immediately by inserting the chip. Recorded as null rather than false: there is no Apply to reach, which is different from an Apply that cannot be reached.
commit_path.second_interaction_note: Reopened after the Platform chip was added; Platform is correctly no longer offered.

controls.label: Platform (added via Add filter)
controls.on_click: Panel opens with 4 checkboxes (Stripe, Shopify, PayPal, Amazon) plus Clear and Apply.
controls.observed_after_first_toggle: Panel visible: true. Apply hittable: true.
controls.observed_after_second_toggle: Panel visible: false. Apply hittable: false. The panel is gone on the second toggle: the second selection was never committed and Apply cannot be pressed. Remove controls on the Platform chip: 0. Add filter re-offers Platform: false.
controls.note: Liveness asserted by isVisible() + hit test. Checkbox state alone reports correctly here, which is exactly why state is not evidence.
